name: Figure Technology
technique: Social Engineering; Vishing; Adversary-in-the-Middle (AitM) Phishing; SSO Credential Compromise; Access Control
rootCause: In January 2026, Figure Technology suffered a breach when ShinyHunters exploited vishing and real-time SSO/MFA credential theft, exposing nearly one million customer records with names, addresses, contact info, and birth dates. No funds or blockchain assets were lost; the breach was entirely off-chain, enabled by credential compromise and weak access controls. A Figure Technology employee was deceived by a vishing campaign. The attacker led the employee to a phishing page mimicking the legitimate Okta portal, captured SSO credentials and MFA codes, and registered their own device as an authenticator.
